instruction: A candid documentary photograph showing a full-body, low-angle shot of a young couple walking hand-in-hand on a stone city sidewalk. They are positioned in front of a brick building with a dark blue storefront. On the right, the man in the pink sweater and brown beanie (R1) walks forward with a small black camera bag slung across his chest, smiling warmly down at his partner. On the left, the woman in the white jacket and yellow-lined vest (R2) walks beside him, holding his hand and looking up at him with a joyful, affectionate smile. The scene is bathed in bright, natural daylight that casts soft shadows on the pavement, emphasizing the warm tones of the pink sweater and the brick background.
